{{Quote|A mainstay of the Gran diet, but perfectly suitable for anyone wanting a light meal.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Goatgrass salad''' was a mainstay staple of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Diet/Legends|diet]]. The [[Salad/Legends|salad]] consisted of fragrant [[Silvergrass|goatgrass]] tossed with [[Malastarian croutons]], a [[houjix cheese]] crumble, and [[three-eyed Kinyenian potato]]es.<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the salad, where it could be purchased for 4.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner's [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], wrote in the menu that goatgrass salad was suitable for anyone wanting a light meal.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Goatgrass salad was introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
